{{Top|italics=1}}
'''''The Pilot and the Rebellion''''' was a document written by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], and was required viewing for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] undergoing recruitment. It covered topics such as the purpose of the Rebellion, the requirements of pilot training, and an overview of the pros and cons of Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] models.
